Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَا تَنْقَضِيْ عَجَائِبُ عَظَمَتِهِ
Translation: O He whose wonders of greatness never end

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ احْجُبْنَا عَنِ الْإِلْحَادِ فِيْ عَظَمَتِكَ
Translation: And protect us from denying Your greatness

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا تَنْتَهِيْ مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ
Translation: O He whose kingdom's duration has no limit

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَعْتِقْ رِقَابَنَا مِنْ نَقِمَتِكَ
Translation: And free our necks from Your vengeance

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ
Translation: O He whose treasuries of mercy never deplete

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ لَنَا نَصِيبًا فِيْ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And grant us a share in Your mercy

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُوْنَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الْأَبْصَارُ
Translation: O He whose vision eyes cannot reach

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَدْنِنَا إِلَى قُرْبِكَ
Translation: And bring us near to Your proximity

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الْأَخْطَارُ
Translation: O He before whose might all dangers are insignificant

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ كَرِّمْنَا عَلَيْكَ
Translation: And honor us before You

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الْأَخْبَارِ
Translation: O He before whom the hidden secrets are manifest

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَفْضَحْنَا لَدَيْكَ
Translation: And do not disgrace us before You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهَّابِينَ بِهِبَتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, make us free from need of gifts from others by Your gift

Arabic text: وَ اكْفِنَا وَحْشَةَ الْقَاطِعِينَ بِصِلَتِكَ
Translation: And suffice us from the loneliness of being cut off by Your connection

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا نَرْغَبَ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مَعَ بَذْلِكَ
Translation: So that we do not desire anyone with Your generosity

Arabic text: وَ لَا نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أَحَدٍ مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: And we do not feel lonely from anyone with Your favor

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ كِدْ لَنَا وَ لَا تَكِدْ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: And plan for us, not against us

Arabic text: وَ امْكُرْ لَنَا وَ لَا تَمْكُرْ بِنَا
Translation: And devise for us, not against us

Arabic text: وَ أَدِلْ لَنَا وَ لَا تُدِلْ مِنَّا
Translation: And help us prevail, and do not let others prevail over us

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ قِنَا مِنْكَ وَ احْفَظْنَا بِكَ وَ اهْدِنَا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And protect us from You, guard us by You, and guide us to You

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إِنَّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ
Translation: And do not distance us from You, for whoever You protect is safe

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ وَ مَنْ تُقَرِّبْهُ إِلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ
Translation: And whoever You guide knows, and whoever You bring near to You gains

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اكْفِنَا حَدَّ نَوَائِبِ الزَّمَانِ
Translation: And protect us from the harshness of time's calamities

Arabic text: وَ شَرَّ مَصَايِدِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ مَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ
Translation: And the evil of Satan's traps and the bitterness of the ruler's assault

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا يَكْتَفِيْ الْمُكْتَفُوْنَ بِفَضْلِ قُوَّتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, those who suffice themselves do so by the grace of Your strength

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اكْفِنَا
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and suffice us

Arabic text: وَ إِنَّمَا يُعْطِيْ الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ
Translation: And those who give, give from the abundance of Your wealth

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعْطِنَا
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and give to us

Arabic text: وَ إِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِيْ الْمُهْتَدُوْنَ بِنُوْرِ وَجْهِكَ
Translation: And those who are guided are guided by the light of Your face

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنَا
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and guide us

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلَانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ
Translation: O Allah, whoever You befriend will not be harmed by the desertion of deserters

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْعُ الْمَانِعِينَ
Translation: And whoever You give to will not be diminished by the prevention of preventers

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إِضْلَالُ الْمُضِلِّينَ
Translation: And whoever You guide will not be led astray by the misguidance of misguiders

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ امْنَعْنَا بِعِزِّكَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and protect us by Your might from Your servants

Arabic text: وَ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ غَيْرِكَ بِإِرْفَادِكَ
Translation: And make us free from need of others by Your provision

Arabic text: وَ اسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَ الْحَقِّ بِإِرْشَادِكَ
Translation: And guide us on the path of truth by Your direction

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ سَلَامَةَ قُلُوبِنَا فِيْ ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ
Translation: And make the safety of our hearts in remembering Your greatness

Arabic text: وَ فَرَاغَ أَبْدَانِنَا فِيْ شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
Translation: And the occupation of our bodies in thanking for Your blessings

Arabic text: وَ انْطِلَاقَ أَلْسِنَتِنَا فِيْ وَصْفِ مِنَّتِكَ
Translation: And the release of our tongues in describing Your favors

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ دُعَاتِكَ الدَّاعِينَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And make us among Your callers who invite to You

Arabic text: وَ هُدَاتِكَ الدَّالِّينَ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: And Your guides who direct to You

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ خَاصَّتِكَ الْخَاصِّينَ لَدَيْكَ
Translation: And among Your special ones who are close to You

Arabic text: يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Most Merciful of the merciful
